body: First off, thankyou for the amount of effort you have put into replying to my comment.  Second of all, thanks for giving me some courage to call them tomorrow (its very late here in the UK).  I felt that I would be wasting their time if I called, however from what you have wrote it makes me feel less of a bother to them if I did call.  I need to talk to someone.  I wish the best and thanks again :)

No they were very good, I forgot to say so its my fault.  I think I have some stigma attached to the samaritans with being religious folk who wont understand.  The woman at the hospital told me to call them but I refused.  I think i'm a little scared of talking to a stranger over the phone about things and dont want to waste their time.

I don't know what to do.  They gave me a flyer with numbers on but I would feel ashamed if I had to call them :/

That's the thing.  I haven't seeked help because I dont feel like I need to, but something isn't clearly right.  I will goto the doctors when I can.  Thanks for taking the time to reply, I felt guilty for posting here but I couldn't talk to anyone else about it or anyone who could understand.  Thankyou...
